integrity: The canonical two-dimensional equations and standard parameter normalization were checked in a peer-reviewed model account. The 1961 provenance and date anchor were checked against public bibliographic records. The strongest same-object stability and limit-cycle literature, a singular-Hopf paper, and a modern six-decade review were compared at statement and implication level. Published semantic-index searches covered invariant-measure, speed-weighted, Hopf-slope, moment, and threshold formulations. The exact energy identity and standard-parameter arithmetic were independently replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures of the autonomous planar FitzHugh–Nagumo model.
The condition \(\varepsilon b<1\) is necessary, not sufficient, for non-equilibrium compact recurrence.
The theorem does not determine limit-cycle existence, period, amplitude, or stability for a given current.
The strongest older Lyapunov/global-dynamics papers were only partially accessible in the inspected route and remain the principal originality risk.
No novelty is claimed for the equations, nullclines, local Hopf calculation, or known canard and bifurcation structure.
title: Global Hopf-slope calibration in the FitzHugh–Nagumo oscillator
